description: Tell SuliHuli that data was missing, a figure looks wrong, or ask for something the catalog does not have. Use it when the user agrees to report it, e.g. 'the EV9 GT price for Canada is missing' or 'the IONIQ 5 WLTP range on the page is the old one'. Name the model, page or tool and what you expected. No names, e-mails or other personal details. Up to 1 000 characters, 5 messages an hour. Returns recorded and the address of the corrections log.

kind.description: missing_data (we hold no such figure or page), data_error (a figure or fact looks wrong), request (something to add).

locale.description: Language of the answer's text and page links (default en): en.

message.description: What was missing or wrong, with the model slug, page address or tool name.

name: send_feedback

url.description: SuliHuli's public corrections log, where fixes show up.

title: Send SuliHuli feedback
